text: Ocean currents move heat, nutrients, and organisms around the planet. Surface currents are driven mainly by winds; deep currents by temperature and salinity differences. The Gulf Stream warms Western Europe far beyond its latitude. Upwelling zones bring nutrients up, feeding rich fisheries.
